subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: S.M. Sultan was a renowned artist of Bangladesh. He was an artist of twentieth century. He studied in a town school but could not continue because of poverty. At the age of 15 he went to Kolkata. A local Zamindar supported him financially. He travelled around India and sketched a lot of portraits. His first exhibition was held in Simla. But he did not preserve his works because he was indifferent to his life. Just before the partition of India, he came back to Narail and settled down in an abandoned building. His first exhibition in Dhaka was in 1978. He was declared the man of Asia in 1982 by the University of Cambridge. Besides, he won the Ekushey Padak in 1982, Bangladesh Charu Shilpi Samsad Award in 1986 and the Independence Award in 1993.
